paragraphs.source_en: A producer does whatever is necessary to accomplish desired results, to get the golden eggs. A parent who washes the dishes, an architect who draws up blueprints, or a secretary who types correspondence is a producer.

units.source_en: A producer does whatever is necessary to accomplish desired results, to get the golden eggs.
A parent who washes the dishes, an architect who draws up blueprints, or a secretary who types correspondence is a producer.

paragraphs.source_en: But when a person sets up and works with and through people and systems to produce golden eggs, that person becomes a manager in the interdependent sense. A parent who delegates washing the dishes to a child is a manager. An architect who heads a team of other architects is a manager. A secretary who supervises other secretaries and office personnel is an office manager.

paragraphs.source_en: A producer can invest one hour of effort and produce one unit of results, assuming no loss of efficiency.

units.source_en: A producer can invest one hour of effort and produce one unit of results, assuming no loss of efficiency.

paragraphs.source_en: A manager, on the other hand, can invest one hour of effort and produce ten or fifty or a hundred units through effective delegation.

paragraphs.source_en: Management is essentially moving the fulcrum over, and the key to effective management is delegation.

units.source_en: Management is essentially moving the fulcrum over, and the key to effective management is delegation.
### GOFER DELEGATION

paragraphs.source_en: There are basically two kinds of delegation: “gofer delegation” and “stewardship delegation.” Gofer delegation means “Go for this, go for that, do this, do that, and tell me when it’s done.” Most people who are producers have a gofer delegation paradigm. Remember the machete wielders in the jungle? They are the producers. They roll up their sleeves and get the job done. If they are given a position of supervision or management, they still think like producers. They don’t know how to set up a full delegation so that another person is committed to achieve results. Because they are focused on methods, they become responsible for the results.
